scope.benchmark_environments: pinned isolated Docker or τ subprocess environment

coverage: Both pinned EnterpriseOps domains opened isolated environments and used the original verifier.
Scripted ReAct routes called the selected real read-only MCP tools, received official scores, and verified session/container cleanup.
Task failure from read-only engineering actions was expected; no task-success claim is made.

verification.suite: pinned τ ReAct and Plan route tests
coverage: Retail and telecom exercised both ReAct and Plan with the pinned original τ evaluator and scripted simulator/judge callbacks.
The Plan path invoked the original domain tools; environment and transcript cleanup assertions passed.
The τ samples are fixed train fixtures, not official test-split scores.

verification.suite: public supervisor, route, ledger, live-runner and offline verifier regressions
coverage: Unknown route and judge states, persisted score and cleanup status, frozen scheduling and resume behavior.
Budget/ledger boundaries, supervisor ownership, and original verifier error handling on synthetic data.

verification.suite: route cleanup and τ deadline/cancellation regressions
coverage: Cleanup failure remains a failed route while preserving score evidence.
Blocked or over-deadline τ subprocess operations are bounded and owned worker descendants are reclaimed.

verification.suite: Ruff on the changed integration test

limitations: This is controlled engineering evidence, not the authorized live first-wave experiment.
No model-quality, public benchmark score, cost, latency, or Jev benefit conclusion follows from these tests.
The live eight-route first wave, 24-case smoke, and 206+80 formal benchmark remain unrun in this cohort.
Existing historical first-wave routes marked failed or unknown were not replayed.
